meta.title: Notepad
meta.description: A per-workspace floating notepad in the session view. New segment cards lead the list, each card has an editable title; click an index to select, drag to reorder, merge a selection, and improve one or all cards with AI. Paste or pick images as path-based chips; removing a chip cleans up plugin-owned files. Pending counts appear on the hidden launcher and the sidebar workspace row. Insert, replace, or send one or many; sending archives automatically. Archived segments can be shown, hidden, restored, and deleted. Resizable and dark-mode aware.
